## What changes for the user?

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue if there is one.

## Verification

List checks run and relevant Blockbench steps, screenshots, or example files. State anything untested. Documentation-only changes can use a read-through and link check.

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] I read CONTRIBUTING.md and kept this change focused.
- [ ] I included relevant generated outputs, or explained why none are needed.
- [ ] I removed connection credentials, private files, and unrelated personal content.
- [ ] I have permission to contribute the included code, models, and textures under the project's license.
